biotools.summary: EMF-Portal is a comprehensive, systematically curated database and literature search platform from RWTH Aachen University, summarizing research data on the effects of electromagnetic fields (EMF) on animals and plants, available in both English and German. It offers search capabilities and information on limits and regulations.
